# Projek PBO Akhir - Database Schema

## Membuat Database

```sql
CREATE DATABASE "hitung_hpp";
```

## Struktur Database

### Tabel Users
```sql
CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "id" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "nama" varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  "email" varchar(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  "password" varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  "role" varchar(20) NOT NULL
);
```

### Tabel Kategori Menu
```sql
CREATE TABLE "kategori_menu" (
  "id" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "nama" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  "deskripsi" text,
  "created_by" integer
);
```

### Tabel Supplier
```sql
CREATE TABLE "supplier" (
  "id" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "nama" varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  "telepon" varchar(20),
  "alamat" text,
  "created_by" integer
);
```

### Tabel Bahan Baku
```sql
CREATE TABLE "bahan_baku" (
  "id" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "supplier_id" integer,
  "nama_bahan" varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  "satuan" varchar(20),
  "harga_per_satuan" float,
  "stok" integer,
  "created_by" integer
);
```

### Tabel Menu
```sql
CREATE TABLE "menu" (
  "id" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "kategori_id" integer,
  "nama_menu" varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  "harga_jual" integer,
  "margin_persen" float,
  "deskripsi" text,
  "created_by" integer
);
```

### Tabel Resep
```sql
CREATE TABLE "resep" (
  "id" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "menu_id" integer,
  "bahan_baku_id" integer,
  "jumlah_dibutuhkan" float,
  "produk_yang_dihasilkan" float,
  "created_by" integer
);
```

## Foreign Keys

```sql
ALTER TABLE "kategori_menu" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("created_by") REFERENCES "users" ("id");
ALTER TABLE "supplier" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("created_by") REFERENCES "users" ("id");
ALTER TABLE "bahan_baku" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("supplier_id") REFERENCES "supplier" ("id");
ALTER TABLE "bahan_baku" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("created_by") REFERENCES "users" ("id");
ALTER TABLE "menu" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("kategori_id") REFERENCES "kategori_menu" ("id");
ALTER TABLE "menu" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("created_by") REFERENCES "users" ("id");
ALTER TABLE "resep" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("menu_id") REFERENCES "menu" ("id");
ALTER TABLE "resep" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("bahan_baku_id") REFERENCES "bahan_baku" ("id");
ALTER TABLE "resep" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("created_by") REFERENCES "users" ("id");
```
